bull.b: Cibus's Trait Machine achieved a step-change in editing efficiency and single-cell regeneration in wheat. This durable platform advancement increases throughput, shortens development cycles, lowers per-trait costs, and broadens crop applicability, supporting scalable trait pipelines and long-term commercial optionality.

Concrete commercial actions in LATAM — LOI, import permit, delivery of edited materials and seven active seed relationships — create a tangible early revenue pathway. Regional deployment in 2027 and equivalence determinations reduce regulatory friction and diversify commercialization beyond U.S. timing risk.

Significant capital raises plus meaningful reductions in R&D and SG&A materially extended runway into late Q1 2027. The combined effect of fresh capital and cost discipline reduces near-term financing pressure and gives management time to execute commercial launches and convert pilots into revenue.

bear.b: Persistent, large absolute cash outflows relative to a small revenue base mean ongoing funding needs. Sustained burn increases probability of future dilution or restrictive financing, limits discretionary investment in scale-up, and places pressure on meeting commercialization milestones without additional capital.

Extreme negative margins and outsized operating losses indicate the business is far from breakeven. Continued erosion of returns and interest on royalty liabilities reduce equity resilience, constrain reinvestment, and heighten reliance on external capital until margins sustainably improve.

Many commercialization arrangements remain non‑binding or early-stage, meaning revenue timing and scale are uncertain. Coupled with a U.S. launch delay tied to third-party herbicide registration, this structural dependency on partner execution and external approvals raises the risk that expected royalties may be delayed or diminished.
